en.headline: Police arrest two men linked to Sun Yee On after Granville Road brawl
en.dek: Officers recovered a chopper and rattan cane after a Friday evening fight in Tsim Sha Tsui that left one man injured.
body: Police have arrested two local men aged 32 and 36 on suspicion of fighting in a public place after a brawl on Granville Road in Tsim Sha Tsui on Friday evening.

The incident took place at about 6.30pm near the junction with Shun Yee Street. Eyewitnesses and social media footage showed a group of about ten people exchanging blows, with some using wooden sticks. One man in a white shirt was seen with facial and head injuries, while another punched a driver inside a parked car. Onlookers, including a tourist with an infant, fled the scene.

By the time officers arrived, the participants had dispersed. The case was taken over by the Yau Tsim District Anti-Triad Squad. Officers found a red-white-blue bag discarded nearby containing a chopper and a rattan cane.

Investigations suggest both arrested men have ties to the Sun Yee On triad society. They remain in custody as police continue to investigate the cause of the clash and locate others involved. No other arrests have been announced.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀加連威老道打鬥 警方拘捕兩名新義安相關男子
zh.dek: 周五傍晚十多名男女在街頭混戰，一名男子受傷，警方在現場檢獲開山刀及藤條。
body: 警方拘捕兩名分別32歲及36歲的本地男子，涉嫌在公眾地方打鬥。事件於周五傍晚約六時半在尖沙咀加連威老道近信義街交界發生。
目擊者及社交媒體片段顯示，約十名男女互相追逐及打鬥，部分人使用木棍。一名穿白衫男子頭部及面部有血，另一名男子則在停泊車輛內毆打司機。現場有遊客抱著嬰兒逃走。
警方到場時參與者已散去。案件交由油尖區反黑組跟進。警員在附近發現一個紅白藍尼龍袋，內有開山刀及藤條。
調查顯示兩名被捕男子均有新義安背景。他們現被扣留，警方正調查打鬥原因及追緝其他涉案人士。暫無其他拘捕公布。
